The '''Data Bio-Encryptor''' was a data transfer system manufactured by [[Servenidain Securities, Limited]]. Used by [[Courier/Legends|couriers]], information was encoded onto a [[microchip]] via a chip encoder, then encased in a jell-like capsule. The capsule was then ingested for travel. The capsule's surface had a chemical coating that prevented digestion, and could be adjusted to be regurgitated at a specific time.
